from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # A stripe is a row whose cells are a nonzero uniform color.
    stripes = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
               if row and row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    n = len(stripes)
    if not n:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    pattern = [color for _, color in sorted(stripes, key=lambda item: item[0] % n)]
    return [[pattern[r % n]] * len(grid[0]) for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
p=progdir/'task-94edab72.py'
p.write_text(code)
# load transform from source
ns={}; exec(code,ns)
f=ns['transform']
# demos
D1=[[0]*21 for _ in range(21)]
for r,c in [(2,9),(3,8),(11,2),(14,5),(20,3)]: D1[r]=[c]*21
O1=f(D1)
expected1=[3,2,9,8,5]*4+[3]
print('demo1', [row[0] for row in O1]==expected1)
D2=[[0]*6 for _ in range(6)]; D2[0]=[5]*6; D2[5]=[6]*6
O2=f(D2); expected2=[5,6,5,6,5,6]
print('demo2', [row[0] for row in O2]==expected2)
T=[[0]*30 for _ in range(30)]
for r,c in [(0,9),(1,7),(8,2),(27,2),(29,8)]: T[r]=[c]*30
out=f(T)
print('pattern', [row[0] for row in out])
